positioning.coverTagline: A little curiosity goes a long way.
positioning.hook: Nothing down here makes sense. That's the point.
positioning.description: Alice follows a hurrying rabbit out of a dull afternoon and into a world with no rules she recognises. Everyone she meets is certain she is the strange one. Working out who she is turns out to be the only way home.
positioning.whyNow: Wonderland is a story about being the only person in the room who thinks the rules are odd. For a reader who feels out of step with everyone around them, Alice is not lost. She is the only one asking.

artDirection.lighting: Moonlight from behind, warm lantern and bioluminescent fill from below. Wonderland glows from inside itself.
artDirection.negativePrompt: photo-real, horror, gore, modern clothing, text artefacts, extra fingers, watermark, harsh contrast
artDirection.characterAnchor: Alice: a girl of about eleven, long wavy blonde hair with a black bow, pale blue dress with a white pinafore, white stockings, dark buckled shoes. White Rabbit: white fur, pink inner ears, blue waistcoat, gold pocket watch on a chain. Cheshire Cat: violet and indigo striped fur, luminous eyes, impossibly wide grin. Mad Hatter: oversized green top hat with a 10/6 price card, wild pale hair, crimson bow tie, mismatched tailoring. March Hare: tawny fur, long upright ears, brown bow tie. Dormouse: small and round, half-closed eyes. Queen of Hearts: black and crimson gown with heart motifs, dark curled hair, gold crown set with rubies. King of Hearts: white beard, red and ermine robe. Recurring props: the gold pocket watch, a floral porcelain tea set, drifting playing cards.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Somewhere around eleven and entirely unimpressed by being told how things are done. She argues with a queen because the argument is obviously correct. Her courage is not fearlessness, it is refusing to pretend something makes sense when it doesn't.
anchors: pale blue dress with white pinafore
white stockings and dark buckled shoes

voice.direction: Bright, level, thinking aloud. Never shrill.

characters.name: White Rabbit
characters.description: Permanently late for something he never explains. Apologises while running away from you.
anchors: gold pocket watch on a chain

characters.name: Caterpillar
characters.description: Asks Alice the only question in the book that actually matters, and is unhelpful about the answer on purpose.

characters.name: Cheshire Cat
characters.description: The only one in Wonderland who tells Alice the truth, and only ever sideways. Arrives grin first and leaves grin last.

characters.name: Mad Hatter
characters.description: Stuck at six o'clock and making the best of it. The rudeness is a game. The kindness underneath is not.
anchors: oversized green top hat with a 10/6 price card

characters.name: March Hare
characters.description: Agrees with the Hatter about everything, including the things the Hatter has just contradicted.

voice.direction: Loud, eager, a beat behind the joke.

characters.name: Dormouse
characters.description: Asleep for most of the conversation and somehow still the one who says the strangest thing in it.

characters.name: Queen of Hearts
characters.description: Rules by volume. Everyone obeys her and nobody is actually afraid, which is the part she cannot bear.

voice.direction: Theatrical, escalating, enjoys her own fury.

characters.name: King of Hearts
characters.description: Quietly pardons everyone his wife sentences, and hopes she doesn't notice.

characters.name: The Gryphon
characters.quote: It's all her fancy, that: they never executes nobody.
characters.description: Escorts Alice everywhere she is sent and complains about it the whole way. Tells her, flatly and correctly, that none of the Queen’s sentences are ever carried out — the only creature in Wonderland who says so out loud.
anchors: eagle head, hooked beak and feathered forelegs with talons
lion's body, hindquarters and tufted tail
tawny gold plumage over a deep russet coat
folded wings held close unless moving

voice.direction: Blunt and brisk, cutting people off mid-sentence. Never unkind.

characters.name: The Mock Turtle
characters.quote: Once I was a real Turtle.
characters.description: Weeps steadily through an account of a school where the lessons lessen by a day each day. The Gryphon insists he has no sorrow at all. Both things appear to be true.
anchors: a calf's head on a turtle's body — Tenniel's joke, and the fixed design
calf's hooves for forefeet and a long calf's tail
green-brown shell over soft ochre hide

voice.direction: Heavy and sighing, on the edge of tears from the first word.

objects.name: Pocket Watch
objects.caption: Time slips away.
objects.meaning: The Rabbit's panic made portable. Time in Wonderland is something done to you.

objects.name: Drink Me Bottle
objects.caption: Smaller?
objects.meaning: The first thing Alice does here is change her own size on a stranger's instruction.

objects.name: Eat Me Cake
objects.caption: Bigger?
objects.meaning: Growing up, taken literally, and not obviously an improvement.

objects.name: Playing Cards
objects.caption: Rules are flexible.
objects.meaning: An entire court that is, on inspection, made of paper.

objects.name: Tea Set
objects.caption: Always tea time.
objects.meaning: Ritual with the meaning worn off, repeated forever.

objects.name: Mad Hatter's Hat
objects.caption: Curiosity included.
objects.meaning: Still priced at 10/6. He never took the ticket off.

objects.name: Flamingo Mallet
objects.caption: An unusual weapon.
objects.meaning: A game where the equipment has opinions.

objects.name: Hedgehog Ball
objects.caption: Mind the spikes.
objects.meaning: Nothing in Wonderland consents to being used.

objects.name: Queen's Crown
objects.caption: Power can be fragile.
objects.meaning: Heavy, gold, and resting on a woman nobody genuinely fears.

objects.name: Captured Butterfly
objects.caption: Even madness is beautiful.
objects.meaning: Wonder pinned under glass. What Alice refuses to become.

audio.narration: Single narrator, warm and close, with light character colouring rather than full impressions.
audio.tone: Playful and dry. Let the nonsense land flat and trust it to be funny.
audio.score: Sparse music box and celeste, wide reverb, no percussion. Drops out entirely under the Caterpillar.
